articles.summary: Emmanuella Amoako, MD, MWACP, FGCP, was honored with the Pediatric Oncology Yvonne Award during the Yvonne Awards Ceremony at OncoDaily Party 2026, held on May 29 at Park West in Chicago. articles.summary: Abstract Background: Limited representation of African populations in cancer genomics constrains the clinical applicability of precision oncology. articles.summary: Abstract Background: Triple‑negative breast cancer (TNBC) is disproportionately common among women of African ancestry and is associated with aggressive clinical behavior and limited therapeutic options. Understanding demographic and contextual determinants of TNBC across African countries is essential to improving prevention, early detection, and precision oncology strategies.
